answer: Make each new identity pay a recurring proof-of-work toll tied to time: an agent must solve a memory-hard puzzle every epoch to stay eligible, so running 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 times the compute, continuously. Rewards are capped per puzzle-solver, so splitting yourself never pays. A new account starts at the low ridge of the reward curve and climbs only through months of paid upkeep; a whisper network of fakes cannot skip that trellis of elapsed time.
